newsitem.title: FRANCE: BNP may be favoured for CIC buy - paper.
newsitem.headline: BNP may be favoured for CIC buy - paper.

text.p: Banque Nationale de Paris (BNP) seems better placed than Societe Generale to take over CIC, the bank which is part of state insurer GAN and being privatised, Les Echos newspaper said on Thursday.

"With the privatisation commission to make its position known imminently -- perhaps today -- on the admissability of the offers from Societe Generale and BNP, BNP seems better placed at the moment," the newspaper said.

According to certain sources offers from the two banks for CIC were roughly equivalent, in the region of six or seven billion francs, but the BNP offer appeared technically superior as far as the terms and conditions attached to the sale by the government were concerned, the newspaper said.
In an interview in Le Figaro newspaper BNP chairman Michel Pabereau declined to comment on the CIC privatisation file.
Neither the BNP nor the Societe Generale have confirmed that they are making offers for the CIC bank.
